Name: [- uL Vias -]
Description: uL Vias focuses on clear, efficient routes for speed leveling, quality‑of‑life additions, and high‑value farms. It’s actively maintained and will keep expanding with new paths, farms, and quality‑of‑life tweaks that the community find fun or genuinely useful.
Categories: General, Leveling, Farming, Gathering, Hero Point Train, Raids

Name: [fast] TacO Markers
Description:
A set of markers and trails for some of the most profitable solo-farming gathering routes across a wide range of maps.
Click the Info button for current benchmarks and more details!

Name: [FvD] Dungeon Markers
Description: Trails for all dungeon explorable and story paths (excluding Arah Story mode). Includes: Path info, mechanics, and some skips.

Name: [MOAR] Marker Pack
Description: The MOAR Marker Pack aims to help players run efficient open world metas and Hero Point trains.

Name: [RACE] Beetle Racing Tracks
Description:
A selection of tracks created and curated by the members of [RACE].

[RACE] Discord Link: https://discord.gg/wkJbRwA

Name: Abaddon
Description: EoD and LW1 set of markers to make achievement chasers' life easier, also has some QoL markers for EoD

Name: Aixxel's HP train guides
Description: This pack contains guides for Aixxel's Chill and Fast HP trains. Includes Heart of Thorns, Path of Fire, End of Dragon's and Vision's of Eternity. Chill routes grab all the waypoints as well while fast focuses on HP and only the waypoints needed for the run. Also shows Comm port enter and exit locations.

Name: Apo's Boss Markers
Description: This pack aims to provide guidance for the Kela Raid Encounter. It displays the positions of the Executor of Waves spawns (numbered), the area of in which waves trigger depending on Kelas position in the arena, and a spot from which you can comfortably reach all Executor of Waves spawns with 1500 range.

Name: Aurizara's HP Train Guides
Description: Detailed paths and markers for portals, hazards and instructions for running on and hosting HP Trains in all three expansions.
Categories: Hero Point Train, HoT Content, PoF Content, EoD Content

Name: Automatic Arrows
Description:
Struggling to find markers that have no trail? Tired of having to backtrack after a marker you just missed?
Look no further! Automatic Arrows is a helper script that can work with any other marker pack. It automatically generates arrows that point to the markers closest to you. Requires Lua Scripts to be turned on in Pathing settings.

Name: Convergence Corp Trails
Description:
A Marker/Pathing pack for Convergences!
Includes pathing for private Convergences (public soon) and some JW hearts.
https://convergencecorp.net/

Name: Czokalapik's Guides
Description: This marker pack is designed for Commanders leading HP trains and/or solo players (with small requirements). Very few challenges require Springer, original routes requiring only HoT masteries and/or gliding are not included for some Hero Challenges (for example Glided River).

Name: Emythiel's GW2 Markers
Description:
Currently only contains a Hero Point train for Heart of Thorns (Verdant Brink, Auric Basin and Tangled Depths).
The path is designed with the idea that anyone could follow as long as they have the Gliding Basics mastery (no other masteries needed aside from Itzel Poison Lore for 1 HP in Tangled Depths).

Name: Flooch's Friendly Collection Routes
Description: A collection of trails for various collections (formerly Tear Token Pack).

Name: Haskha's Markers
Description: A collection of markers for raids and strikes.

Name: Heart Zones
Description: Zone outlines shown on your map for each of the hearts in-game.

Name: Hero's Marker Pack
Description: This pack provides skip guides, mechanical optimization, encounter strategy support, and general QoL markers for Fractals of the Mists, Raids, Strikes, and Dungeons, in addition to limited build support for SFTA. Individuals who are significantly experienced in end-game PvE content will see little to no use from this pack, and the same goes for brand new players. But if you're someone who doesn't fit in either extreme, then this pack will suit you well.
Categories: Fractals, Raids, Strike Missions, Dungeons, Builds, Gathering

Name: HeroineDark's Guides
Description: Random guides to help players and enhance experiences with the game.
Categories: Festivals, Raids, Fractals, Dead Content, Tyria Pride Parade

Name: Japyx's Trails
Description: This Marker Pack is designed for an easy Home Instance gathering with trails, markers and bandit chest locations.

Name: KevPack
Description: Marker pack made for farming Magic Mirrors on Castora. Includes key reminders and instructions.

Name: Lady Elyssa's Achievements & Collections
Description: This pack focuses on Achievements & Collections for the Living World and all Expansions.

Name: Lady Elyssa's Guides
Description: A comprehensive marker pack covering Chest Runs, Festivals, Gathering,  Guild Missions, Hero Points (HoT, PoF, EoD), Jumping Puzzles, Key Farming, Map Completion, World Bosses, Living World and more...
Categories: Festivals, Jumping Puzzles, Gathering, Map Completion

Name: Linus's VoE Chest Farm
Description: Paths and Makers for farming Magic Mirrors and Chests from VoE maps.

Name: Mad King's Labyrinth - Commander Pack
Description: This marker pack includes everything you need to know in order to learn how to command a Mad King's Labyrinth farm -- including trails, informational markers and even generic copy-paste messages for new commanders.

Name: Mesmer Fractal Skips
Description: Trails and markers for most of the practical Fractal skips done with Mesmer (some might require prior knowledge).

Name: Metal Marker Myriad (MMM)
Description:
A collection of random marker packs for various collections, achievements, whatever! It's like a box of chocolates!

https://discord.gg/FP8dQj6KBj
Categories: Achievements, Farming, Festivals, Fishing, Gathering, Mastery Insights, Map Completion, PSNA

Name: Movement on the World [EN/FR]
Description: Providing quest-like, scenic and at times challenging map tours, to get familiar with the zones and their (Meta-)events. Come learn about the zones or try a permadeath challenge while following the zones tours, alone or with a group of friends :D

Name: Nekres' Hoard of Lost 'n Forgotten Markers
Description:
A collection of markers which at the time of creation were not covered by other packs.
Currently includes:
- Treasure Mushroom hiding spots
- A Carved Path (Grothmar Valley).

Name: Neltisen's VoE Mirrors
Description: Daily large and medium obscured chests paths.  SWS and SW zones utilise HP for needed keys. EG zone uses mirror resets and reruns. Follow description plaques at the end of each path if in doubt.

Name: Nexploration
Description: This marker and trail pack is for all y'all looking to map-comp all of Cantha and start building out those sweet new legendaries. I've also created a few extra trails as well, adding in mastery routes, JP's and some achievement routes. I may or may not add more routes in the future, just depends on personal time.

Name: Only Fish
Description:
NOW INCLUDED IN MMM. IF YOU HAVE THAT PACK, YOU CAN DELETE THIS PACK.  A collection of known Fishing Hole spawn locations across all available maps, categorized by type! Never sail aimlessly again!

https://discord.gg/FP8dQj6KBj

Name: PEAK Infallible Markers
Description: The PEAK marker pack for Infallible

Name: Pewpew's Power Paths
Description:
Official open world Roller Beetle Racing paths designed to help you get an easy gold medal in each race following the exact racing path of "Masked Roller P" (Currently only primary Roller Beetle races, as well as a few difficult seasonal races. More to come in the future along with speed updates).

[TINY] discord server link: https://discord.gg/tinyarmy & website: https://tinyarmy.org/

Name: ReActif EN
Description: (English Version) Follow the trails to complete the map explorations (as well as masteries).\n\nThe trails are adapted to be able to be followed by having not all the masteries or the mounts. These are used only from the maps where the player can get them.

Name: ReActif FR
Description: (French Version) Follow the trails to complete the map explorations (as well as masteries).\n\nThe trails are adapted to be able to be followed by having not all the masteries or the mounts. These are used only from the maps where the player can get them.

Name: Rediche's WvW Marker Pack
Description:
Level up your World vs. World skills with the ultimate World vs. World Marker Pack!

Discord: https://gw2.link/discord
Github: https://github.com/rediche/rediche-wvw-pack

Name: ShinysTrails
Description: Routes and markers for farming Magic Mirrors from VoE, and some extras/more to come.

Name: Teh's Trails - Map Completion
Description: A pack tailored for speedrunning map completion. It utilizes all mounts, waypoints, and a multitude of markers to help you complete maps as fast as possible. The current map comp world record of 6h48m uses this pack! Includes trails for Core Tyria, EoD and SotO, with HoT and PoF in progress.

Name: Teh's Trails - Hero Points
Description: This pack contains trails for speed-completing Hero Points either solo or in small groups. It is aimed at veteran players who have access to most masteries and want to quickly grab hero points for their new alt. Requires all mounts, prototype position rewinder, and jade waypoint.

Name: Tekkit's All-In-One
Description: Jack-of-all-trades with markers and trails for most content.
Categories: Festivals, Jumping Puzzles, Achievements, Gathering, Map Completion

Name: The Tryhard Marker Pack
Description: The Tryhard Marker Pack

Name: Triple Trouble Markers
Description: Markers for Triple Trouble. Escort paths, Egg and Husk Spawns, Husk landing spots, Vet Wurm spawns, and head specific placements. Whether you are commanding, condi or zerg, this pack can help you with position and locations to achievements for all things Triple Trouble related.

Name: Twisted Castle
Description: Markers for Twisted Castle (Raid Wing 3). Features: Meta pathing, (Slower) Intended Pathing, Buttons, and Gate Portals

Name: Tyria [DRFT]
Description:
This is Tyria Drift's [DRFT] main marker pack that compiles many [DRFT] racetracks made by [DRFT] members for GW2 players to try out. 

[DRFT] Discord server link: https://discord.gg/6gE5GYV

[DRFT] discord server link: https://discord.gg/6gE5GYV

Description: This marker pack has the locations of magic mirrors and obscure chests.

Light weight End of Dragons zipline paths with no extra fluff.
